discipline: unknowns preserved exactly as recorded; classification is mechanical (each entry records the rule that fired); each entry's resolution action, expected measurement, acceptance rule, consequence and priority are derived from THAT unknown's own subject and cited record ids — the roadmap answers: what exactly must a technical team do next to remove this uncertainty? (R425 §6)
